notes:
PROSPECT SNAPSHOT:
- Company: Olive Aisle Labs — marketplace focused on specialty grocery + household goods. Catalog ~12M SKUs (master + variants). Fresh items + seasonal bundles add churn.
- Primary need: semantic catalog search + product reranking to lift conversion on long-tail queries and seasonal promos. Emphasis: index scale, per-query cost, and predictable latency under flash sale spikes.
TIMELINE (recent):
- 2025-11-05: inbound trial request via website; basic requirements form completed.
- 2026-01-12: scoping call (CTO + Head of Search) — discussed hybrid retrieval and rerank budget.
- 2026-02-18: demo + live sketch of reranking flow (SE present). Fireflies: ff-2026-02-18-oliveaisle-call-374.
- 2026-03-01: technical deep dive; Redwood SE to run baseline embedding build on sample shard.
USE / TECH DETAILS / REQUIREMENTS:
- Catalog: ~12M canonical SKUs, daily delta ingestion ~150k; updates per item expected 1–2x/day. Need near-real-time incremental indexing (target update visibility 2–4 minutes for top sellers).
- QPS targets: baseline 25–40 qps; normal peak 180–250 qps; Black Friday-like peaks ~800–1,200 qps for short windows (10–60 mins).
- Latency SLOs: 95th percentile end-to-end search+rerank <= 120ms; p99 ideally < 250ms. Rerank step must not add >40–60ms on critical paths.
- Cost sensitivity: target operational cost per query (search + embedding retrieval + rerank) <= $0.0008–$0.001 during peaks; aim to evaluate batching + caching to reduce unit cost.
- Retrieval plan: hybrid (lexical prefilter + ANN for recall). Currently evaluating Pinecone & in-house FAISS; Redwood to propose candidate-count tradeoffs (top-50 prefilter vs top-10).
- Rerank approach: BERT-ish cross-encoder only for top-K (investigate K=5 vs 20) vs cheaper late-interaction model. Want RedwoodOptimize recommendations for K and quantization.
SECURITY / COMPLIANCE:
- Requires SSO (SAML), audit logs, KMS integration, and EU data residency for EU storefronts. Security RFI in progress (drive:/security/oliveaisle/sec-rfi-answers.docx).
QUOTES & DECISION CRITERIA:
- "If our per-query cost doubles during sale windows we lose margin — need clear cost model for rerank at scale." — CTO (paraphrase).
- Decision drivers: predictable peak pricing, ability to run in VPC, low-latency rerank, rollout tooling for canary/rollback during promotions.
POC SCOPE (agreed):
- 2-week POC to: (1) ingest representative 1.2M shard, (2) build embeddings + ANN index, (3) run synthetic traffic profile with Redwood serving rerank models, (4) measure cost per query at baseline and at 1K qps, (5) validate latency SLOs and fallback behavior.
NEXT STEPS / ACTIONS:

- Security team to review RFI answers; final SAML integration window TBD.
- Blocker: need signed NDA + sandbox access credentials for ingestion samples.

- Competitive concerns: already trialed Algolia + Pinecone; team looking for lower cost per rerank and unified rollout controls.
